newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kingspan sells Ward steel business.
newsitem.headline: Kingspan sells Ward steel business.

text.p: Irish building products group Kingspan Group Plc said on Friday it had sold the structural steel business of its British Ward subsidiary to a management buy-out team.
The sale also includes the continental European pre-fabricated buildings business, which is run by Atlas Bausysteme GmbH.
Kingspan said the MBO team paid 2.5 million stg cash and 1.2 million preference shares.
The book value of the net assets totalled 4.1 million stg at the of 1996 and annual turnover was 49.3 million stg.
Kingspan bought the Ward business, which included Atlas and the building components and structural steel businesses for 25.9 million stg from Britain's Rugby Group Plc in January this year.
